note: Re-quoted 2026-11-25 to the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0; library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz, read offline as owb-am), per the founder decision of 2026-11-18 (Amharic quotes OWB everywhere). This supersedes what the notes below say about the 1962 UBS Bible and about wording borrowed from other Amharic works: every `mined` row is now a verbatim OWB span in its block (exact OWB pieces may be joined with '…'); `self_rendered` rows are allusions and paraphrases left as the translator's prose.

Scripture authority is the 1962 Amharic Bible (UBS; NT revised 2003). Its New Testament is on disk whole (ebible mirror gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/amh_amh); the mirror has no Old Testament, so OT quotations reuse a shipped Amharic work's wording where one quotes the same verse (source_file names it) and are otherwise self_rendered in the 1962 register.

A `mined` row was re-measured against the finished text: an exact byte substring of at least 20 characters of the 1962 NT verse (or 25 of the cited shipped work) inside that block. Shorter, re-personed, or bridged-range verses (the mirror merges some verse ranges into one entry holding only part of the text) are self_rendered.
